mug_felix: My previous assumption that the mug follows a static path (kitchen table in morning, desk in evening) is incorrect. On day 12, the mug was at kitchen_table_k1 at 07:52, moved to desk_b1 by 15:54, shifted to coffee_table_l1 by 22:17, and ended at sink_k1 by 22:59. The mug moves frequently and unpredictably between kitchen, bedroom, and living room spots throughout the day. Do not assume a fixed location based on time of day. Always prioritize the most recent confirmed location from the latest patrol or feedback. If no recent data exists, check the most recently visited room by Felix, but be prepared for the item to be in any of the common spots (kitchen_table_k1, desk_b1, coffee_table_l1, sink_k1).

glasses_felix: Previous note to check bed_b1 for late-night queries was incorrect. The item was at bathroom_shelf_ba1 in the morning and coffee_table_l1 in the late evening. It does not stay in the bedroom. Check bathroom_shelf_ba1 for morning queries and coffee_table_l1 for late-night queries.

glass_felix: Previous note to check kitchen_table_k1 for evening queries was incorrect. The item was at kitchen_table_k1 in the afternoon but moved to cupboard_k1 by late night. It does not remain at the table. Check kitchen_table_k1 for afternoon queries and cupboard_k1 for late-night queries.

tablet_felix: Previous note to check bed_b1 for late-night queries was incorrect. At 21:09, the item was at nightstand_b1, not the bed. Check nightstand_b1 for late-night queries.

General Note: Felix’s items do not follow static daily cycles. The mug is highly volatile, moving between at least four different spots in a single day. Glasses, glass, and tablet have more predictable but time-dependent locations. Always prioritize the most recent confirmed location over assumed patterns, especially for the mug.
